emails.subject: URGENT: Temperature Excursion Alert - Study DNL593-001 - Site 101 (UCSF) - Shipment SH-481516
emails.body:
Hi Lisa,

Hope you are well.

We received shipment SH-481516 for the DNL593-001 study this morning. Upon unpacking, the temperature monitoring device indicated an excursion alert.

The shipment has been immediately placed in quarantine in our pharmacy as per protocol. Please find the downloaded temperature log attached for your review.

Could you please advise on the next steps and whether the investigational product is viable for use?

Best regards,

David Chen
Study Coordinator
University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) Memory and Aging Center

emails.subject: Fwd: URGENT: Temperature Excursion Alert - Study DNL593-001 - Site 101 (UCSF) - Shipment SH-481516
emails.body:
Hi Kevin,

Please see the urgent notification below from UCSF (Site 101) regarding a temperature excursion for an IP shipment.

Could you or someone from the Clinical Supply team please review the attached temperature log and provide an assessment on the viability of the DNL593/Placebo kits in shipment SH-481516?

The site has correctly quarantined the product pending our guidance.

Thanks for your prompt attention to this.

Best,

Lisa Jones
Clinical Research Associate
Denali Therapeutics

emails.subject: RE: URGENT: Temperature Excursion Alert - Study DNL593-001 - Site 101 (UCSF) - Shipment SH-481516
emails.body:
Hi Lisa,

Thank you for flagging this. We have reviewed the temperature data for shipment SH-481516.

The excursion was for a brief period and remained within the product's stability limits. The investigational product is deemed viable and acceptable for use in the study.

Please find the official Viability Statement attached. The site should file this with their pharmacy records for the shipment.

Let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,

Kevin Miller
Manager, Clinical Supply
Denali Therapeutics

emails.subject: RE: URGENT: Temperature Excursion Alert - Study DNL593-001 - Site 101 (UCSF) - Shipment SH-481516
emails.body:
Hi David,

Thank you for your prompt action in quarantining the shipment and notifying us.

Our Clinical Supply team has reviewed the temperature log and has confirmed that the product is viable and may be used. Please see the attached Viability Statement for your records.

You can now release the IP from quarantine and move it to your standard temperature-controlled storage. Please file the attached statement in the pharmacy binder for this shipment.

We appreciate your diligence.

Best regards,

Lisa Jones
Clinical Research Associate
Denali Therapeutics

description: A discussion with a site about a temperature excursion alert for a shipment of DNL593/Placebo, requiring coordination with the clinical supply team to determine if the investigational product is viable for use.
